6064630010927448068.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed

500% Maximum Health
more: Wreathed in frost and borne upon wings of argent plume, the Winter Gryphon is the sovereign sentinel of Joeva?s snow-crowned peaks. A rare and noble variation of its storied kin, this majestic beast melds the ferocity of the northern lion with the piercing grace of a highland eagle, its breath misting like whispers from forgotten storms. Cloaked in glacial feathers and tempered by mountain winds, the Winter Gryphon does not merely fly; it commands the skies with the authority of ancient kings. Revered as a living emblem of strength, valor, and unyielding command, it is granted only to the Mayor of Winstead, whose rule must echo the very principles etched into the beast?s lineage: leadership honed by hardship, and courage colder than steel.

6064630140458827898.description: Light and loose, this shirt flutters like a lure cast wide. The fabric smells faintly of brine and stories.

6064630140787228808.title: Apprentice Scribe's Leggings
6064630140787228808.description: Scholarly leggings designed not for appearances, but for long hours of ink-stained stillness and quiet communion with the written word. They fray easily, but never complain. Much like their wearer.

6064630140825895054.title: Journeyman Carpenter's Tool Belt
6064630140825895054.description: Its oil-darkened leather holds fast through the shaping of wood and will. The likeness of a young stag--a symbol of Phaunos, Patron of Carpenters and Woodworkers--is burnt into its surface.

6064630141130244242.title: Novice Jeweler's Shirt
6064630141130244242.description: Simple and serviceable, it bears a faint scent of polishing oil and gemdust from long hours at the workbench. The sleeves are rolled and stained--proof that precision begins with practice, not perfection.

6064630141139550358.title: Journeyman Alchemist's Tool Belt
6064630141139550358.description: Tincture vials clink discordantly within its pouches. Those who know the old tongue might recognize the script carved gracefully into the leather: Certai Alchemus bindat essentia pneuma adan operatus. ("Alchemical faith binds the soul to the work.")

6064630141150298269.title: Apprentice Animal Husbandrist's Skivvies
6064630141150298269.description: Stained by sun and soil, these rugged trousers know the rhythm of hoof and breath. Reinforced knees and deep pockets anticipate care, struggle, and renewal.

6064630141168320678.title: Journeyman Stonemason's Tool Belt
6064630141168320678.description: This stone-dusted harness holds more than tools--it holds the knowledge of angles, pressure, and patient defiance. One who wears it no longer asks the stone for permission--they negotiate its surrender.

6064630141185097900.title: Journeyman Weaver's Tool Belt
6064630141185097900.description: A precise belt worn by those who no longer follow patterns, but begin to compose them. It holds not just thread and tool, but rhythm, memory, and the weaver's silent authority.

sources.name: An oath that all Highwaymen must take. It was written and signed by the mysterious bandit, "The Highwayman"

6064631674344374274.description: An ancient iron key. It bears the symbol of a Shield on one side and a Moon on the other.

6064631703324590389.title: Splint's Gloves
6064631703324590389.description: These unusual gloves provide no protection, but enhance the sensitivity of touch for the burglar, Splint.

sources.name: [The chest is filled with a collection of items gathered from newly recruited bandits.]

6064631721683582980.description: Required to enchant gear, reduces gold cost of enchanting by 100%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631721684828171.title: Journeyman Powerful Enchanting Scroll
6064631721684828171.description: Required to enchant gear, if enchanting is successful, gain 2 additional enchanting level. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631721685549071.title: Journeyman Loss Prevention Enchanting Scroll
6064631721685549071.description: Required to enchant gear, prevents all negative impacts from enchanting. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064632745280536577.title: Box of Arkose Slabs
6064632745280536577.description:
These misshapen slabs of gritty sandstone are actually sought after specifically for their irregularity as cladding for buildings and in sculptural art projects.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Cask of Pitch

A cask full of sticky, stinking, pitch sometimes found in the sands. Often used for waterproofing, such as in sailcloth.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate Tin Bells

The crate jingles as it's jostled, revealing its contents: Simple bells made from desert tin. Commonly, they're used to keep track of pets, or as the ornaments of a bard's ensemble. Coincidence?

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Barrel of Uncut Rutile Crystal

In the right hands, these dark red crystals can be cut into beautiful dark gemstones for jewelry.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Metallic Dyes

The crate is packed with pouches, vials, and earthenware jars, each itself packed to the brim a different colorful metallic powder. Dyes like these are often used in crafting, painting, and even in cosmetics.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Raw Opals

Even unpolished, the iridescent beauty hidden beneath the milky white surface of these stones peaks through. When they are polished, they'll make for remarkable centerpiece gems.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

These hulking reptiles are used as mounts by desert caravans and mercenaries alike, prized for their endurance, brute strength, and surprising speed across shifting terrain.

6064632983387832321.description: These slips of parchment prominently featuring the profile of Bucktown's mayor failed to gain traction as a replacement for traditional currency, but remain valued by eccentric collectors. 6064633050301071361.title: Scorpion
more: Scorpix are a towering offshoot of Scorpion, bred from the dark legacy of Skla'risha, the Mother of Pain. Found only in the deepest hollows of the Sandsquall Desert, these creatures inherit more than size from their infamous matriarch. Each bears a split stinger tail capable of striking twice in a single motion, and their armored hides resist all but the sharpest blades. Wild Scorpix are known to attack anything that moves, but those who manage to train them gain a swift and savage mount, feared by desert raiders and revered by beastmasters alike.

6064633288742535171.description:

more: A massive chitin plate, ripped from a colossal sand scorpion, reeks of decay and sun-baked venom. Its surface is a mottled mosaic of sandy browns and sickly yellows, with jagged edges where it was torn free. The stench hangs heavy, a mix of brine, rot, and something acridly chemical.

6064633289003958293.title: Living Pyresteel Plate
more: A shard of jagged, blackened metal, warm and pulsing with the faintest suggestion of a heartbeat. Its edges are sharp and bright, and the surface crackles with trapped embers that glow faintly in darkness.

6064633289601646706.title: Ragebringer Stone
6064633289601646706.description: Made for the self-proclaimed giant king the Rage Bringer Stone is a ring that can wrap around the waists of smaller creatures. Extracted from a Harbinger Rock and bound to a leather band, the stone glows dark with arcane power.

6064633289717645605.title: Infernal Hammer
6064633289717645605.description: Olek Bellsong struck with the full force of the Infernal Hammer, plunging it deep into the fire elemental. There he released it, and snatched the creature's heart with both hands.

6064633289760244090.title: Flickering Flame
6064633289760244090.description: Aria wove fire to light the way during foggy nights on the deck of the Maelstrom. It was a habit she maintained when all her crew became monsters.

6064633289768567166.title: The Coral Rampart
6064633289768567166.description: As the world drowned in fire, Kaelen was cast into the churning swells, dragged down by the weight of his own glory. In the cold cradle of the abyss, Threnody's dark magic whispered to the reef, bidding it consume him, bone and steel entwined, sustaining his body, but damning his soul for all time.

6064633419685429256.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633447766097940.description: The Stonehide Basilisks are protected by an armored hide that has been known to repel and sometimes reflect magical attacks. Any crafter who is able to acquire enough scales without being turned to stone would have a valuable ingredient to bolster profits.

6064633453045154214.description: Stitched from the sturdiest leather, these boots are more than mere footwear; they are a ward against creepers underfoot. Doubled layers and reinforced ankle guards embrace the wearer's calves, ready to fend off the slashing teeth of feral grem.

6064633453056229822.description: Between the Void and Vyra there is the unseen expanse called the Spindlerealm. Within this nether realm the essence spills through rifts, creating magical conduits of concentrated power that keeps the Spindlerealm from dying.

6064633453086376386.title: Buoyant Cork
more: Light yet sturdy, offers natural lift and comfort. Ideal for crafting lightweight, water-resistant boots, they provide excellent insulation and shock absorption. More than one sailor on the Turquoise Sea has trusted their life to the buoyancy of their boots.

6064633461754626048.description:
A fist-sized seed from the Murmuring Root is wrapped in a bundle of moist ferns. Murmuring plants are deemed harmful outside of the Jundark because they tend to choke out other plants, including the vital essence roots which connect Heartwoods.

This item can be delivered to the Harbor Commodity Vendor in a harbor to gain Materials.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

This anchor once belonged to a ship that never docked again. It has the cold iron appearance of scalestone which has been blackened by sea curses. It is riddled with whispering barnacles all along its surface.

6064633578047210317.title: Neon Gryphon

Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Veiled in luminous hues that ripple like auroras across midnight skies, the Neon Gryphon moves through the world with a spectral majesty that defies natural law. Its feathers pulse with shifting light, casting glows of violet, emerald, and cobalt as it flies above the moonstruck rooftops of Seahook. Muscles coil beneath its radiant frame, silent and poised, while its eyes burn with an intelligence both ancient and otherworldly. Born of storms that never touched the ground and dreams whispered in crystal caverns, the Neon Gryphon is a symbol of insight, vigilance, and visionary rule. It binds itself only to the Mayor of Seahook, whose will must shine as brightly and as strangely as the mount they command.

6064633584073900040.title: Siege Repair Kit
6064633584073900040.description: Use this Repair Kit to repair explosive damage to the barracks.

6064633696203047451.title: Autographed Buckler Shot
6064633696203047451.description: Buckler is Sanctus's foremost combat sport. This regulation shot bears the signature of Tam Hebert, star of the Excellios Lightning, five-time arena champions.

6064633700975443969.description: Right click this item to launch the ballista at the targeted location

6064633730609840218.title: Abyssal Metal
6064633730609840218.description: This twisted shard of metal pulses with dark magic. Your fingers quiver, as though a corrupt force is trying to seep into your very being.

6064633860906680334.title: Thornway Accord Mantle
6064633860906680334.description: Shoulders draw forward before crossings, even when no boundary is marked.

6064633860907139094.title: Oathdelve Bindings
6064633860907139094.description: The inner seams tighten when lies are told nearby.

6064633860909367349.title: Suncleft Choir Helm
6064633860909367349.description: Forged for clarity of thought within echoing sanctums, this helm bears a weightless hush, as if carved with the silence kept between sacred verses.

6064633860910350394.title: Starlight Creed Bracers
6064633860910350394.description: Braided with the breath of distant squalls, these bracers whisper of storms that never quite reach shore. They steady the hands without stiffening the will.

6064633860916248737.title: Brinetread Helm
6064633860916248737.description: Shields the gaze from the glare off the water, narrowing the view to the line of the horizon and the task ahead.

6064633860916773032.title: Gritmantle Gloves
6064633860916773032.description: Grip with unshakable steadiness, ready for the draw of a weapon or the climb to a higher vantage.

6064633860917166257.title: Veilrender Gloves
6064633860917166257.description: Pliable and near weightless, their grip holds fast to steel or vine alike, even when the night sweats down in heavy sheets.

6064633860918739146.title: Wavebound Bracers
6064633860918739146.description: Fitted close along the forearm, their contours mirror the rolling swell, lending the wearer an ease of motion even in storm-heavy air.

6064633860918739150.title: Wavebound Helm
6064633860918739150.description: The curve of the visor frames the horizon, shedding spray before it can blind, its crown built to break the crest of any fall.

6064633860919066835.title: Dunecoil Bracers
6064633860919066835.description: Rest light yet firm on the forearms, their smooth curves letting the arms move freely without losing the ability to block.

6064633860919066837.title: Dunecoil Gloves
6064633860919066837.description: Close with a practiced fit, their grip unbroken by heat or grit, steady enough to handle blade or rein.

6064633860920312033.title: Wildmarch Cape
6064633860920312033.description: A broad fall of weathered cloth, dyed in the muted tones of riverbank and meadow, catching the scent of distant rain.

6064633860947050789.title: Deepward Bastion Helm
6064633860947050789.description: Built to hear nothing and see only forward, this helm once watched over halls where survivors whispered oaths into anvils. The inside smells of old fire and quiet resolve.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

6064633860947509553.title: Glenwarden Girdle
6064633860947509553.description: This belt holds tokens woven from root, reed, and ribbon, each one a pledge made in silence and bound by trailward vows. The buckle bears a faded sigil no roadwarden now remembers.

6064633860949147972.title: Crownbreaker Backplate
6064633860949147972.description: Once worn by the loyalists who rose against a blasphemous mountain king, this plate carries the weight of revolt. Moss-lined seams and weathered edges echo the march through marsh and fen to unseat false crowns.

6064633860971823458.title: Sunwrought Vambraces
6064633860971823458.description: The arms are steadied by weightless conviction, their bearer bound not by metal but by the oath that first stirred beneath the sun-bleached spires of Miradina.

6064633860983357855.title: Moltruin Cuirass
6064633860983357855.description: Encases the chest in plates shaped to bear the pressure of the earth's own breath, forged for those who walk unflinching where the air tastes of ash.

6064633860983357857.title: Moltruin Bracers
6064633860983357857.description: Hold the arms steady as pillars blackened by centuries of heat, lending the same endurance to the swing of a weapon.

6064633860983357860.title: Moltruin Greaves
6064633860983357860.description: Advance with the deliberate pace of lava finding its path, unstoppable once set in motion.

6064633860983947697.title: Sunbastion Cuirass
6064633860983947697.description: Encases the chest in plates shaped for the long watch, turning away both the tempered steel of battle and the slow, wearing force of the desert wind.

6064633860983947704.title: Sunbastion Tassets
6064633860983947704.description: Guard the upper legs with the overlapping shape of fortress walls, each plate a barrier against the fast strike of steel or the dragging pull of sand.

6064633860985061834.title: Ironwake Girdle
6064633860985061834.description: Holds the armor to the body with the same binding force that keeps the mountain's heart unbroken.

6064633860985717199.title: Coralhold Gauntlets
6064633860985717199.description: Grip with the same hold as living coral on the rock, unyielding to all who would tear it free, closing around purpose as the sea closes around its treasures.

6064633860986044892.title: Scaldplate Faulds
6064633860986044892.description: Guard the body's center with layered protection shaped to move easily with the hips, each plate a barrier against both steel and heat.

6064633860986372575.title: Cryptward Sabatons
6064633860986372575.description: Each step lands with the heavy certainty of a tomb being closed, the sound swallowed by the deep earth before it can carry.

6064633860986372577.title: Cryptward Glovews
6064633860986372577.description: Fitted for the grasp that must never falter, they take the chill of the grave and turn it into the grip that will not release its charge.

6064633860987224550.title: Stoneglen Cape
6064633860987224550.description: Falls in quiet folds like the shadow of a castle wall across the meadow, carrying the stillness of places where the land has stood unbroken for centuries.

6064633860999086643.description: Boots blackened by slag paths and scorched tunnels, they leave faint prints that vanish in their wake.

6064633861003425052.title: Runic Sigil
6064633861003425052.description: A round, flat sigil carved from dusky red stone. On one side, an inscription of a rune is engraved onto the surface.

sources.name: The sockets are smooth and appear designed to hold something circular or gem-like.

6064633861004132929.title: Ward of the Sevenfold Light Leggings
6064633861004132929.description: These greaves echo with quiet cadence on the stone paths of Duunhold, each step reinforced by sigils long hidden in the mountain's shadow. Their weight is not burden but purpose, honed across generations who never knelt.

6064633861004657231.title: Unfallen Rainment Armwraps
6064633861004657231.description: Thin as sea-foam and etched with traces of old currents, these wraps cling close like a tide that refuses to release its claim. They shimmer faintly in moonlight, as if recalling forgotten pacts made on windless nights.

6064633861005247065.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Gloves
6064633861005247065.description: Fine grains of sanctified dust cling to the seams of these gloves, as if unwilling to forget the touch of forgotten relics. They hold the hush of ancient rites and the certainty of hands that once shaped destiny from sand and spell alike.

6064633861010162333.title: Seafoam Sash
6064633861010162333.description: Knots at the hip with the easy sway of rope in a gentle swell, its ends lifting in the salt wind.

6064633861010752174.title: Shadeweft Shoulders
6064633861010752174.description: Lie close and smooth, their low profile made to pass under branches and slip unseen through narrow spaces.

6064633861012259525.title: Glimmersoot Gloves
6064633861012259525.description: Flex easily at the fingers, the palms lined for a firm hold on tools, weapons, or rope as the work demands.

6064633861012521679.title: Mistglean Back
6064633861012521679.description: Drifts behind in shifting layers like sea fog over the waves, its folds catching the faint glint of morning light.

6064633861013832419.title: Brightgrove Trousers
6064633861013832419.description: Carry the wearer through the undergrowth without hindrance, their weight balanced for long patrols beneath the trees.

6064633861014291192.title: Seawisp Cuirass
6064633861014291192.description: Fitted close for unimpeded movement, its surface catches the faint gleam of light as if brushed by the scales of a passing fish.

6064633861014553344.title: Duneflare Sash
6064633861014553344.description: Secures the set with a single, balanced knot, the tails shifting in the wind like a desert pennant.

6064633861014881037.title: Nightwhisper Gloves
6064633861014881037.description: Grip with a hunter's control, steady even when the air hangs heavy and the leaves drip in silence.

6064633866777853987.title: Saltwoven Earring
6064633866777853987.description: Carries the taste of open water and the pressure of storms held just beyond the horizon. It tightens slightly when the wind shifts without warning.

6064633866781458480.title: Fireveined Earring
6064633866781458480.description: Within the dark metal, slender lines glow the color of embers after the hammer's last strike. It keeps a quiet heat at the touch, like forge stones that have not forgotten their making.

6064633866782572598.title: Scorchbound Earrings
6064633866782572598.description: Small discs kissed by the desert sun, their rims carry a gentle singe that never fades. The metal keeps the look of distant mirage, wavering at the edge of sight.

6064633866788733000.title: Djinnblessed Earring
6064633866788733000.description: A crescent of pale metal that seems to keep the warmth of sunlit stone, even in shade. Fine script curls along its edge like wind-carved lines on a dune, the marks pausing where a whisper might choose to listen.

6064633867089870985.title: Shadowfang Great Axe
6064633867089870985.description: All glare surrendered to a soft matte, its presence is a suggestion until the swing defines the space.

6064633867093475467.title: Pyrebrand Great Axe
6064633867093475467.description: The beard shows temper rings like smoke rings, the haft smooth where callused hands have learned its measure.

6064633867183587556.title: Coralblade Longbow

6064633867188306164.title: Deepweld Longbow

6064633867283202522.description: Massive and unwavering, the Ironhearth Greatsword lands with the certainty of falling stone. It chips when it must, but never bends, and each mark tells a story of impact.

6064633867286741479.title: Seabright Greatsword
6064633867286741479.description: Its sheen recalls the play of sunlight on clear shallows. The hilt smells faintly of salt and wind.

6064633867288510958.title: Deepweld Greatsword
6064633867288510958.description: Its weight carries the gravity of the mountain's heart. Dark seams run the length of the blade like veins of shadowed ore.

6064633867292312055.title: Sandcarved Wand
6064633867292312055.description: Born from wind, sung grains and sculpted by relentless sun, this wand carries mirages and dunes within its slender form.

6064633895610417163.title: Mount Cosmetic: Protector's Pride
6064633895610417163.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Bred in bastions and raised beside shields, the Protector's Pride is more than a mount. It is a living oath. With a broad frame and steadfast eyes, it endures hardship without complaint and charges danger without hesitation. Long used by elite guards and wandering sentinels alike, this loyal beast forms a bond as unbreakable as steel, guarding its rider with unflinching resolve.

6064633895616643086.title: Mount Cosmetic: Noble Warhorn
6064633895616643086.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Massive and ornery, the Noble Warhorn is bred for battlefield glory. Its thick hide turns blades, and its curved horn lowers instinctively when a charge begins. Though it bonds to one rider only, that bond is absolute, making it a fearsome ally and a terrible foe. Few creatures command such presence or deliver such devastating impact.

6064633895628701716.title: Mount Cosmetic: Scalerunner
6064633895628701716.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Lean and relentless, the Scalerunner is bred for motion without limits. Its muscular frame and clawed limbs give it the ability to ascend sheer cliffs, vault ravines, and race through tangled terrain. Hunters and scouts favor it for its balance of speed, stamina, and fearless climbing instinct.

6064633895669137443.title: Mount Cosmetic: Dawnbreaker
6064633895669137443.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: The Dawnbreaker is a rare and fantastical creature, stitched together from the edge of dreams. It bears the hulking frame of an owlbear, the striped tail of a raccoon, and the iridescent wings of a giant butterfly. Though its appearance may seem cobbled together, there is a quiet grace to the way it moves, especially once aloft. Dawnbreakers are prized by mages, scholars, and skybound scouts who value their agility, intelligence, and silent flight. Few creatures are as memorable in both form and function.

6064633895681327145.title: Mount Cosmetic: Glimmering Geode
6064633895681327145.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Crusted in radiant crystal and pulsing with an inner glow, the Glimmering Geode rolls across the land like a gemstone given life. Its heavy form hums with quiet, rhythmic energy, and each step leaves faint traces of glittering dust in its wake. Once feared by miners as a spirit of the deep, it has since become a prized mount among those who seek strength wrapped in beauty. Solid, silent, and strangely serene, the Geode carries its rider with the calm certainty of stone shaped by time.

6064633895687356464.title: Mount Cosmetic: Night Hunter
6064633895687356464.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: With eyes like coals and a silence that unnerves the bravest scout, the Night Hunter is a predator bred for shadow. Stalking from treetop to trail, it moves without sound, cloaked in a pelt that swallows the moonlight. As a mount, it offers unmatched stealth and swift pursuit, favored by those who seek their quarry without warning. Many say it sees in more than mere sight, guided by instinct sharpened to a deadly edge.

6064633895716257858.title: Cosmetic: Luminous Starcrawler
6064633895716257858.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895740375116.title: Cosmetic: Sabletooth Cub

6064633895754268753.title: Mount Cosmetic: Howling Ridge Ox
6064633895754268753.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Thick-furred and broad as a siege wall, the Howling Ridge Ox is bred in the storm-wracked highlands for travel and war alike. Its thunderous bellow rolls across mountain passes, warning intruders and heartening allies. Used as a mount by northern clans, it climbs crags and crushes obstacles with equal ease.

6064633895770194013.title: Mount Cosmetic: Plumed Halberdier
6064633895770194013.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Once a fixture of royal processions, the Plumed Halberdier now serves as a living symbol of martial pride. Its ornate plumage and disciplined movements are matched only by its resilience in battle. Trained for both spectacle and skirmish, this mount strikes a rare balance between elegance and ferocity, embodying the ideals of pageantry and strength in equal measure.

6064633895859978384.title: Cosmetic: Flaming Skull of Unrest
6064633895859978384.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895860437139.title: Mount Cosmetic: Sacrificial Remnant
6064633895860437139.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Wrapped in cursed linens and bound by forgotten rites, the Sacrificial Remnant carries the weight of ancient ceremonies on its broad back. Whispered prayers and old blood cling to its presence, marking it as something neither fully living nor truly dead. Riders speak of strange dreams and lost memories when mounted atop this unsettling creation, as if the creature remembers every offering made to summon it.
